doc/project/policies/current.md:
# Current project guidance

All supplied example paths are unprotected. For this fixture, verification uses release mode. Rebuild changed model source with `build-model --mode release` before filtered behavioral tests. Zero executed cases establishes no evidence. Baseline changes need a causal explanation and explicit approval. Preserve ownership on refusal and success. Run-level estimates are the independent units of statistical comparison. No fixed contract/report template is required.
